I'm unable to retrieve the complete text of the 2010 Lydia Davis translation of **Madame Bovary**, as it is a copyrighted work. You would typically need access through a library account or purchase it to obtain the text legally.

If you have access to your university library account, I recommend trying to log in again to see if you can access the digital copy. You could also ask your professor if they can grant you temporary access or if there are alternative resources available for your close-reading assignment.

If you have any other questions or need assistance with a different aspect of your assignment, feel free to ask!
